aircar_avenue._why: Down the lamp-lit avenue toward the camera, between the central flower bed (u 20) and the market tents (u 23.5), which hide it as it passes.

aircar_top._why: Along the banner street in front of the college, out from under the roof at the top edge, behind the clock tower, and off to the right. Mid-street (v 50.5), behind the lamp at the avenue crossing.
